sample_unit: patient information leaflets (3 LLMs x 4 urology topics)

links.outcome: Readability (reading level) of LLM-generated patient information leaflets versus adult reading level
links.effect: PaLM 2 PILs simplest (age 14-15 average reading level); Llama 2 most difficult (age 16-17 average); LLM PILs above average adult reading level.
links.quote: LLM-generated PILs were above the average reading level for adults, necessitating improvement in LLM algorithms and/or prompt design.

links.outcome: Comprehensibility of LLM-generated patient leaflets via reading level
links.effect: Readability analysis showed PaLM 2 PILs at age 14-15 and Llama 2 at age 16-17 average reading level, above average adult level.
links.quote: LLM-generated PILs were above the average reading level for adults, necessitating improvement in LLM algorithms and/or prompt design.

links.outcome: Medical inaccuracies in LLM-generated patient leaflets
links.effect: Medical inaccuracies were present in all generated content including instances of significant error.
links.quote: Medical inaccuracies were present in all generated content including instances of significant error.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of three off-the-shelf LLMs (ChatGPT-4, PaLM 2, and Llama 2) for generating patient information leaflets on urology topics, assessing quality, accuracy, and readability without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
